root_cause: CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT puts the font stack on <pre style="font-family:Menlo,..."> but wraps output in a bare <code>. Browser user-agent stylesheets (Chrome) set code { font-family: monospace }, which overrides the inherited pre font, so exported HTML renders in a different font and box-drawing / traceback lines misalign (issue #3104).
best_solution:
In rich/_export_format.py CONSOLE_HTML_FORMAT, change `{code}` to `{code}`, so inherits the font stack from the parent 
 and the user-agent monospace reset is beaten by an inline style. Mirror the neighbouring 
 attribute formatting exactly (inline style, no space after the colon, no trailing semicolon). Nothing else changes; the SVG template and the leading `"""\` stay as they are.
acceptable_alternatives: None pass the hidden tests. They compare the full export_html()/save_html() string, so a CSS rule `code { font-family: inherit; }` in the <style> block fixes the rendering but fails the byte-exact comparison.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_console.py::test_export_html, test_export_html_inline and test_save_html assert byte-for-byte equality of the exported HTML, which must contain `...monospace"><code style="font-family:inherit"><span ...` with no other change to the template (no extra CSS rule, leading newline or SVG changes).
locating_signals: Statement is only 'Fix #3104' / 'See #3104' plus a PR checklist; it names no file, function or symptom. The linked issue title ('font-family ignored in html_export due to user agent stylesheet for <code>') and body ('add a font-family: inherit; on the <code> element') give the whole fix, but the agent never sees them. Without the issue, only existing test_export_html expected strings in tests/test_console.py point at _export_format.py.
our_outcome_summary: Failed in all four configs (v4/v6/v7/v8 kaggle_env_pass false). v4 (100 calls) and v7 (60 calls) produced empty patches. v6 changed an unrelated entry in rich/_cell_widths.py ((73104, 73105, 0) -> 1), apparently pattern-matching the number 3104 against the width table. v8 got the idea (font-family: inherit on code) but added a `code {{ font-family: inherit; }}` CSS rule instead of the inline attribute. It also removed the backslash after the opening triple quote (adding a leading newline), replaced the whole CONSOLE_SVG_FORMAT template with a foreignObject stub, deleted _SVG_FONT_FAMILY/_SVG_CLASSES_PREFIX and left a reproduce_issue.py file behind. It would have failed the byte-exact tests and broken SVG export. p_v4 test log: 3 failed (test_export_html, test_export_html_inline, test_save_html), 93 passed.
generalizable_lesson: When the statement is only 'Fix #N' with no symptom, don't grep the codebase for the number N (it matches unrelated data such as Unicode tables). Recover the intent from local evidence instead: CHANGELOG/docs mentions, existing tests whose expected strings cover the area, and TODO/FIXME comments. When a test compares exact serialized output (HTML, templates), make the smallest edit that follows the formatting of the neighbouring code (here an inline style attribute like the sibling <pre style=...>). Never rewrite unrelated templates or constants in the same file, and delete scratch repro scripts before finishing.
